lockMode.title: Enable Parent-Locked Tamper-Evident Vault Mode
lockMode.description: When true, SurakshaNet encrypts all flagged incidents with parentPublicKey, streams them to the privileged native vault daemon, never stores plaintext in browser storage, and disables clearing or viewing logs in the popup.

parentPublicKey.title: Parent Public Key (Base64 uncompressed P-256 point)
parentPublicKey.description: 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public key generated by surakshanet-vault init. Only the parent's offline private key can decrypt sealed records.

heartbeatSec.title: Heartbeat Interval (seconds)
heartbeatSec.description: Interval for extension liveness heartbeats sent to the privileged daemon. Defaults to 60 seconds.
